name: pinterest-inspiration
description: Visual inspiration MCP plugin with palette quantization, Tesseract OCR metric extraction, computer-vision layout detection, closed-loop visual diff verification, WCAG contrast verification, and bundled anti-slop design skills. Scrapes pins, extracts layout geometry and UI metrics, and converges production UI code.
author: Antigravity Team
suggestedPrompts: Search Pinterest for modern dark SaaS dashboards, extract the quantized color palette and OCR metrics, and build the UI
Detect layout regions and card grid columns from a reference pin using detect_layout_regions
Compare my rendered component screenshot against the reference pin using compare_visual_diff and inspect the heatmap
Find visual inspiration for a minimalist modern coffee shop landing page and audit contrast with calculate_wcag_contrast
